headline: An identity in _eight weeks,_ built in the open.
lede: You see the thinking before the logo and the logo before the system. Every phase ends in a file you keep, whatever happens next.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.summary: We ask what is broken, who it is for, and what would make this a waste of money.
steps.give: 45 minutes and an honest version of the brief
steps.get: A one-page scope and a fixed fee within 48 hours

artifact.alt: A calendar invite for a 45-minute video call with three people and a three-point agenda
artifact.label: Video call
artifact.title: Intro: Kettle & Pike rebrand

steps.title: Strategy workshop
steps.summary: One room, one wall, three hours. We leave with the sentence the whole identity has to prove.
steps.give: A half-day with your founders and one customer-facing person
steps.get: Positioning on one page, signed off before design starts

artifact.alt: A one-page positioning sheet: who it is for, what it stands against, the proof, the voice and what it must never be
artifact.title: The kettle that outlasts the kitchen.
rows: People who buy one good thing, and keep it

steps.title: Two routes
steps.summary: Two distinct answers, never three near-twins. You choose one, or we combine them with a reason.
steps.give: One feedback session, then a choice
steps.get: Two identity routes on 24 slides, each tried on your real materials

artifact.alt: Two presentation slides: route A, a serif wordmark with green and brass, and route B, a bold monogram with vermilion

steps.title: Refine and apply
steps.who: The lead designer on your route
steps.summary: The route meets the real world: small sizes, dark mode, a crowded shelf.
steps.get: Logo suite, type and colour, applied to site, deck and packaging

artifact.alt: The new identity applied to the home page of the shop, with the headline Built to be rebuilt
artifact.headline: Built to be rebuilt.

steps.title: Guidelines and files
steps.summary: Everything a new hire needs to use the brand without calling us.
steps.give: A handover call with whoever runs the brand next
steps.get: 48-page guidelines and an organised file kit

artifact.alt: A spread from the guidelines, pages 31 and 32, on colour: moss leads and brass marks the hand
artifact.title: Moss leads. Brass only marks the hand.
artifact.body: Use moss for anything the customer touches first.
